info.name: Fluxpay M5 Backend — risk, review and Oracle vector acceptance
info.description: Canonical Postman collection for the current M5BackendApplication on port 8082 with m5-risk,m5-backend,m5-m3-integration. Follow docs/M5-POSTMAN-END-TO-END-TESTING.md exactly. Keep signed USER/ADMIN tokens only in private Postman environment Current values. Do not run the whole collection automatically: the current-policy folder is Runner-only, review delivery requires manual polling, and rejection/policy mutation exercises are separate. The default RU recipient and country list are synthetic demo fixtures, not legal or sanctions assertions. Risk and reasons are always computed from authoritative stored data; this collection never submits them. SQL setup, account provisioning, token minting, Kafka, payout, settlement and refunds are outside these HTTP requests. Preserve idempotency keys for replay checks. If confirmation returns 410 QUOTE_EXPIRED, generate a fresh quote and a fresh confirmation key and confirm immediately.

variable.value: Synthetic test policy: manual compliance approval authorizes a new confirmation attempt only while the bound receipt is valid. The sender must obtain a fresh quote and use a new confirmation key. Quote expiry, verified KYC, recipient eligibility and sufficient available funds still apply. PROCESSING records a balanced journal and durable event intent; it does not certify external payout or settlement. Only the current configured demo rules decide risk; policy retrieval does not change their verdict.
What checks still apply after a manual compliance approval?

2. USER token can list owned payments

01. Ollama and current-policy readiness
item.description: Run after Ollama is serving nomic-embed-text and the backend is running. The Ollama request explicitly uses No Auth so your ADMIN token is never sent to the model server.

item.name: 1. Warm Ollama and verify the 768-dimensional embedding

exec: pm.test('Ollama embed endpoint is available', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.equal(200); });

pm.test('Embedding is finite, nonzero and has configured dimensions', function () { pm.expect(vector).to.be.an('array').with.lengthOf(Number(pm.variables.get('expectedDimensions'))); pm.expect(vector.every(Number.isFinite)).to.equal(true); pm.expect(vector.some(v => v !== 0)).to.equal(true); });

item.name: 2. Reconcile canonical hashes — safe to repeat

exec: pm.test('Updated count is a nonnegative integer', function () { pm.expect(body.correlationId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.data.updatedDocuments).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.data.updatedDocuments).to.be.at.least(0); });
console.log('Run this request again after the first reconciliation; updatedDocuments should then be 0.');

item.name: 3. Verify all 13 V708 current policies exist

exec: pm.test('All 13 current policy revisions are present', function () { expected.forEach(id => pm.expect(ids, 'missing ' + id).to.include(id)); });

item.name: 02. Index 13 current policies — run this folder with Runner data only
item.description: Use Postman Collection Runner on this folder only with docs/postman/m5-current-policy-ids.json. Set allowPolicyIndexing=true only in your private environment. Each data row first proves the ID/title and then indexes that immutable revision with the configured real provider.

item.name: 1. Verify Runner policy ID and title

exec: if (String(pm.variables.get('allowPolicyIndexing')).toLowerCase() !== 'true') throw new Error('Set allowPolicyIndexing=true in your private environment for this deliberate Runner operation.');
if (!allowed.includes(id)) throw new Error('Runner data contains a policy ID outside the 13-ID V708 allowlist.');
if (!pm.iterationData.get('expectedPolicyTitle')) throw new Error('Runner data is missing expectedPolicyTitle.');

pm.test('Runner row matches immutable policy', function () { pm.expect(body.correlationId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.data.id.toLowerCase()).to.equal(String(pm.iterationData.get('currentPolicyId')).toLowerCase()); pm.expect(body.data.title).to.equal(pm.iterationData.get('expectedPolicyTitle')); });

item.name: 2. Index verified current policy with real provider

exec: if (String(pm.variables.get('allowPolicyIndexing')).toLowerCase() !== 'true') throw new Error('Set allowPolicyIndexing=true in your private environment for this deliberate Runner operation.');
if (!allowed.includes(id)) throw new Error('Runner data contains a policy ID outside the 13-ID V708 allowlist.');

pm.test('Real immutable generation is active', function () { pm.expect(body.correlationId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.data.policyDocumentId.toLowerCase()).to.equal(String(pm.iterationData.get('currentPolicyId')).toLowerCase()); pm.expect(body.data.mock).to.equal(false); pm.expect(body.data.chunkCount).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(body.data.generationId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.data.embeddingSpaceId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.data.replayed).to.be.a('boolean'); });

item.name: 03. Grounded Oracle vector-search acceptance
item.description: Run after the 13-policy Runner folder. These requests distinguish a grounded semantic match from the explicit no-answer path and require mock=false.

item.name: 1. Relevant sender-verification question is grounded

exec: pm.test('Answer uses real indexed policy sources', function () { pm.expect(body.correlationId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.data.mock).to.equal(false); pm.expect(body.data.answer).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.data.sources).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; body.data.sources.forEach(s => { pm.expect(s.policyDocumentId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(s.title).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(s.excerpt).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; }); });

item.name: 2. Unrelated question returns explicit no-answer

exec: pm.test('No unsupported policy answer is invented', function () { pm.expect(body.data.mock).to.equal(false); pm.expect(body.data.answer).to.equal('No grounded answer found in current policies.'); pm.expect(body.data.sources).to.be.an('array').that.is.empty; });

item.name: 04. Direct authoritative risk diagnostic — optional R1 fixture
item.description: First run docs/sql/m5-risk-demo-fixture.sql and paste its paymentId into riskFixturePaymentId. The API returns the fingerprint and sequence; the client never submits risk or reasons. This raw assessment is evidence-only and intentionally cannot be approved until M3 binds a review disposition.

item.name: 1. Read server-owned assessment context

exec: if (!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(String(pm.variables.get('riskFixturePaymentId') || ''))) throw new Error('Run docs/sql/m5-risk-demo-fixture.sql and set riskFixturePaymentId first.');

pm.test('Fingerprint and next sequence are server-derived', function () { pm.expect(body.data.paymentId.toLowerCase()).to.equal(pm.variables.get('riskFixturePaymentId').toLowerCase()); pm.expect(body.data.expectedPaymentFingerprint).to.match(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/); pm.expect(body.data.nextAssessmentSequence).to.be.a('number').and.above(0); });

item.name: 2. Create server-derived R1 assessment

exec: pm.test('R1 fixture produces authoritative HIGH review evidence', function () { pm.expect(body.data.assessmentId.toLowerCase()).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('directAssessmentId').toLowerCase()); pm.expect(body.data.risk).to.equal('HIGH'); pm.expect(body.data.screeningVerdict).to.equal('REVIEW'); pm.expect(codes).to.include('KYC_UNVERIFIED'); pm.expect(codes).to.include('FIRST_TO_RECIPIENT'); pm.expect(codes).to.include('HIGH_VALUE'); });

item.name: 3. Exact assessment replay returns identical result

exec: pm.test('Replay returns the original stored assessment', function () { pm.expect(body.data).to.deep.equal(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('directAssessmentData'))); });

item.name: 4. Changed request with same assessment ID conflicts
5. Inspect evidence-only direct case

exec: pm.test('Direct case can be inspected', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.equal(200); });

pm.test('Raw assessment is not an active payment hold', function () { pm.expect(body.data.risk).to.equal('HIGH'); pm.expect(body.data.reviewable).to.equal(false); pm.expect(body.data.paymentDisposition).to.equal(null); pm.expect(body.data.reviewReference).to.equal(null); });

item.name: 6. Direct case cannot be approved before M3 binding
05. Targeted R2, R3 and R5 scenarios — fresh India-recipient history only
item.description: Run once on a fresh m5-backend-test-data.sql fixture before any other payment to safeRecipientId. Steps 1–4 prove R2 alone is LOW/APPROVE. Steps 5–8 create a second same-day BUSINESS payment and prove R2+R3+R5 is MEDIUM/REVIEW. Clear this folder's ten generated variables before a genuinely fresh rerun.

item.name: 1. Create first safe-recipient payment for R2

exec: pm.test('First targeted payment is DRAFT', function () { pm.expect(body.data.status).to.equal('DRAFT'); pm.expect(body.data.recipientId.toLowerCase()).to.equal(pm.variables.get('safeRecipientId').toLowerCase()); });

item.name: 2. Obtain quote for R2-only payment
3. Confirm R2-only payment — LOW auto-approval

exec: pm.test('One MEDIUM reason still auto-approves', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.equal(200); });

item.name: 4. Inspect R2-only passport

exec: pm.test('R2 alone is LOW and PROCEED', function () { pm.expect(body.data.risk).to.equal('LOW'); pm.expect(body.data.screeningVerdict).to.equal('APPROVE'); pm.expect(body.data.paymentDisposition).to.equal('PROCEED'); pm.expect(body.data.reviewable).to.equal(false); pm.expect(codes).to.deep.equal(['FIRST_TO_RECIPIENT']); });

item.name: 5. Create second same-day BUSINESS payment for R3 and R5

exec: pm.test('Second targeted payment is DRAFT', function () { pm.expect(body.data.status).to.equal('DRAFT'); });

item.name: 6. Obtain quote for R3 and R5 payment
7. Confirm second payment — expected MEDIUM review

exec: pm.test('Second targeted payment is UNDER_REVIEW', function () { pm.expect(body.data.status).to.equal('UNDER_REVIEW'); });

item.name: 8. Inspect R2 plus R3 plus R5 passport

exec: pm.test('Second same-day short-purpose payment is MEDIUM review', function () { pm.expect(body.data.risk).to.equal('MEDIUM'); pm.expect(body.data.screeningVerdict).to.equal('REVIEW'); pm.expect(body.data.paymentDisposition).to.equal('REVIEW_REQUIRED'); pm.expect(body.data.reviewable).to.equal(true); pm.expect(codes).to.include('FIRST_TO_RECIPIENT'); pm.expect(codes).to.include('RECIPIENT_TODAY'); pm.expect(codes).to.include('SHORT_PURPOSE'); });

item.name: A. M3 review walkthrough — run stepwise and wait for delivery
1. Create synthetic owned draft

exec: pm.test('Draft is owned and mutable', function () { pm.expect(body.data.status).to.equal('DRAFT'); pm.expect(body.data.sourceAmount).to.equal(pm.variables.get('sourceAmount')); });

item.name: 2. Obtain original quote

exec: pm.test('Three routes and one recommendation are returned', function () { pm.expect(body.data.quotes).to.be.an('array').with.lengthOf(3); pm.expect(body.data.recommendedQuoteId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.data.quotes.filter(q => q.recommended)).to.have.lengthOf(1); });

item.name: 3. Confirm original quote — expected review fixture

exec: pm.test('Payment is held for review', function () { pm.expect(body.data.status).to.equal('UNDER_REVIEW'); });

item.name: 4. Owner passport — capture authoritative case

exec: pm.test('Authoritative HIGH review contains destination and value reasons', function () { pm.expect(body.data.risk).to.equal('HIGH'); pm.expect(body.data.screeningVerdict).to.equal('REVIEW'); pm.expect(body.data.paymentDisposition).to.equal('REVIEW_REQUIRED'); pm.expect(body.data.reviewable).to.equal(true); pm.expect(reasonCodes).to.include('HIGH_RISK_DEST'); pm.expect(reasonCodes).to.include('HIGH_VALUE'); });

item.name: 5. ADMIN approve held case

exec: if (pm.collectionVariables.get('paymentStatus') !== 'UNDER_REVIEW') throw new Error('Use an active review scenario; do not approve a PROCESSING payment.');

pm.test('Approval is durable and pending delivery or already acknowledged', function () { pm.expect(body.data.status).to.equal('APPROVED'); pm.expect(body.data.verdict).to.equal('APPROVE'); pm.expect(['PENDING','ACKNOWLEDGED']).to.include(body.data.deliveryState); pm.expect(body.data.decisionId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

item.name: 6. Inspect delivery — repeat manually until acknowledged

exec: if (body.data.deliveryState !== 'ACKNOWLEDGED') console.warn('Wait about 10 seconds and send this request again.');

item.name: 7. Owner payment — wait for DRAFT

exec: pm.test('Approval delivery returned payment to DRAFT', function () { pm.expect(body.data.status).to.equal('DRAFT'); });

item.name: 8. Obtain fresh quote after M3 acceptance

exec: if (pm.collectionVariables.get('paymentStatus') !== 'DRAFT' || pm.collectionVariables.get('deliveryState') !== 'ACKNOWLEDGED') throw new Error('Inspect delivery and payment first; M3 approval must be acknowledged and payment DRAFT.');
pm.test('Fresh quote is different from held quote', function () { pm.expect(body.data.recommendedQuoteId).to.not.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('originalQuoteId')); });

item.name: 9. Reconfirm with fresh key and quote

exec: if (pm.collectionVariables.get('reconfirmKey') === pm.collectionVariables.get('confirmKey')) throw new Error('Reconfirmation requires a new Idempotency-Key.');
pm.test('Approved reconfirmation must post', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, '202 means a new review was created; inspect its passport instead').to.equal(200); });

item.name: 10. Replay original key and original quote

exec: pm.test('Original key replays its historical review result', function () { pm.expect(body.data).to.deep.equal(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('firstConfirmData'))); pm.expect(body.data.status).to.equal('UNDER_REVIEW'); });

item.name: 11. Replay reconfirmation key and fresh quote

exec: pm.test('Fresh key replay is identical and remains PROCESSING', function () { pm.expect(body.data).to.deep.equal(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('processingConfirmData'))); pm.expect(body.data.status).to.equal('PROCESSING'); });

item.name: B. Alternative rejection — separate undecided review only
item.description: Do not use a case already approved in folder A. Clear the generated payment/quote/case IDs and idempotency keys, run A steps 1–4 to create a new UNDER_REVIEW payment, then run these three requests instead of A step 5.

item.name: ADMIN reject an undecided active case

exec: if (pm.collectionVariables.get('paymentStatus') !== 'UNDER_REVIEW') throw new Error('Select a separate active undecided review before rejection.');

pm.test('Rejection is durable and pending delivery or already acknowledged', function () { pm.expect(body.data.status).to.equal('REJECTED'); pm.expect(body.data.verdict).to.equal('BLOCK'); pm.expect(['PENDING','ACKNOWLEDGED']).to.include(body.data.deliveryState); });

item.name: 2. Inspect rejection delivery — repeat until acknowledged

exec: if (body.data.deliveryState !== 'ACKNOWLEDGED') console.warn('Wait about 10 seconds and send this request again.');

item.name: 3. Rejected payment has no posting path

exec: if (pm.collectionVariables.get('deliveryState') !== 'ACKNOWLEDGED') throw new Error('Poll rejection delivery until ACKNOWLEDGED first.');
pm.test('M3 recorded rejection without posting', function () { pm.expect(body.data.status).to.equal('REJECTED'); });
